newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Feb lead battery sales fall 3.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Feb lead battery sales fall 3.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's sales of domestic lead batteries, measured in volume of contained lead, fell 3.0 percent in February from the same month last year to 21,200 tonnes, the Japan Storage Battery Association said on Monday.
